meta.name: alterlab-pathml
meta.description: Run full computational-pathology workflows with PathML — whole-slide-image (WSI) analysis across 160+ slide formats, multiplexed immunofluorescence (CODEX, Vectra, MERFISH), nucleus segmentation/classification (HoVer-Net, HACTNet), tissue- and cell-graph construction, HDF5 dataset management, and deep-learning model training on pathology data. Use when the user builds end-to-end deep-learning pathology pipelines, analyzes multiplexed or spatial-proteomics slides, or segments nuclei. For lightweight H&E slide preprocessing, tissue masking, or plain Random/Grid/Score tile extraction prefer alterlab-histolab instead. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你处理病理切片图像：加载160多种格式的全切片图像，进行染色归一化、组织检测、细胞核分割与分类，构建细胞或组织空间关系图，训练深度学习模型（如HoVer-Net），以及分析多重免疫荧光数据（如CODEX）。
howto.when: 当你需要分析病理切片图像（如H&E染色或多重免疫荧光），或构建端到端的深度学习病理分析流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我加载这张SVS格式的病理切片，并进行组织检测。

say.text: 用HoVer-Net对这张切片进行细胞核分割和分类。
say.note: Claude会运行HoVer-Net模型进行分割和分类。

say.text: 分析这个CODEX数据，进行细胞分割和标记物定量。
